docs/configuration.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Optional: chat / response, defaults to chat

docs/configuration.md:code-comment:toml:.source: 手动补充模型列表（API 获取不到时用）
docs/configuration.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Manually supplement the model list (used when the API cannot retrieve it)

docs/configuration.md:code-comment:toml:.source: 本地图片/文件/语音默认 base64；共享文件系统可用 file_uri
docs/configuration.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Local images/files/voice are base64 by default; file_uri can be used for shared file systems

docs/configuration.md:code-comment:toml:.source: 写入与响应等待的基础超时
docs/configuration.md:code-comment:toml:.translation: Base timeout for writing and response waiting

docs/configuration.md:heading:5b7ce9b12c.source: 内置 Web 工具配置

docs/configuration.md:heading:b148a6c8a3.source: 环境变量与进程环境继承
docs/configuration.md:heading:b148a6c8a3.translation: Environment Variables and Process Environment Inheritance

docs/configuration.md:list:035f65d61a617.source: 压缩成功后切换到独立的新 Session，不修改原 Session 的历史。
docs/configuration.md:list:035f65d61a617.translation: After successful compaction, it switches to a new independent Session without modifying the history of the original Session.

docs/configuration.md:list:07eeca2b4f1ee.source: SOUL、记忆和环境文件只检查存在性。
docs/configuration.md:list:07eeca2b4f1ee.translation: SOUL, memory, and environment files are only checked for existence.

docs/configuration.md:list:0da0a72f54e5a.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 工具只能访问调用者自己的数据，因此普通用户可调用；其中 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ / __ELBOT_CODE_2__ 操作仍需本人确认。
docs/configuration.md:list:0da0a72f54e5a.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ tools can only access the caller's own data, so they can be called by ordinary users; however, __ELBOT_CODE_1__ / __ELBOT_CODE_2__ operations still require confirmation from the user themselves.

docs/configuration.md:list:0dbc6c1bbf761.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ only controls the runtime log, supporting __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__, __ELBOT_CODE_3__, and __ELBOT_CODE_4__.

docs/configuration.md:list:0e064aa874ce4.source: 见[文件编辑撤销](commands.md#文件编辑撤销)。
docs/configuration.md:list:0e064aa874ce4.translation: See [Undo File Edit](commands.md#文件编辑撤销).

docs/configuration.md:list:0f3b9a550bd6d.source: Responses 调用当前对话模型的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__，以整个原生返回窗口作为新会话起点。
docs/configuration.md:list:0f3b9a550bd6d.translation: Responses call the __ELBOT_CODE_0__ of the current conversation model, using the entire native return window as the starting point for the new Session.

docs/configuration.md:list:0f99538e6c45e.source: 配置根 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、systemd 环境：重启后生效。
docs/configuration.md:list:0f99538e6c45e.translation: Configuration root __ELBOT_CODE_0__, systemd environment: takes effect after restart.

docs/configuration.md:list:0fd1290517cf8.source: 普通用户只能发现和调用允许风险范围内的工具；通过权限校验后，__ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 风险调用还需当前用户确认。
docs/configuration.md:list:0fd1290517cf8.translation: Regular users can only discover and call tools within the allowed risk range; after permission verification, risk calls via __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ still require confirmation from the current user.

docs/configuration.md:list:120f1a0bcc998.source: Cloudflare R2 可保持 bucket 私有，无需开公共访问；下载方或中转服务必须能访问该链接。
docs/configuration.md:list:120f1a0bcc998.translation: Cloudflare R2 allows buckets to remain private without enabling public access; the downloader or relay service must be able to access the link.

docs/configuration.md:list:12a4bb6b93358.source: 未设置 workspace 时沿用进程工作目录。
docs/configuration.md:list:12a4bb6b93358.translation: When no workspace is set, the process working directory is used.

docs/configuration.md:list:14a455b52a628.source: 只有 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 命中至少一个工具后，本 Session 才激活该 tag 的 prompt。
docs/configuration.md:list:14a455b52a628.translation: The prompt for the tag is activated in this Session only after __ELBOT_CODE_0__ matches at least one tool.

docs/configuration.md:list:14d846325f6ec.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__、插件 __ELBOT_CODE_1__：启动及 __ELBOT_CODE_2__ 时重读，reload 按新环境重建 Worker。
docs/configuration.md:list:14d846325f6ec.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__, plugin __ELBOT_CODE_1__: reread during startup and __ELBOT_CODE_2__; reload rebuilds Workers based on the new environment.

docs/configuration.md:list:191c85590144f.source: 技能工作目录是技能根目录；合并结果由 ElBot 传给子进程，脚本无需自行加载 __ELBOT_CODE_0__。
docs/configuration.md:list:191c85590144f.translation: The Skill working directory is the Skill root directory; the merged result is passed to the child process by ElBot, so the script does not need to load __ELBOT_CODE_0__ on its own.

docs/configuration.md:list:1928046efb279.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__：媒体接收上限，默认 100MB；超限或无法取得时提示媒体不可用。
docs/configuration.md:list:1928046efb279.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__: Maximum media reception limit, default 100MB; a "media unavailable" prompt is shown if the limit is exceeded or the media cannot be retrieved.

docs/configuration.md:list:1ce9e7e66d579.source: 其余看首行 Shell shebang（含 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 写法）。
docs/configuration.md:list:1ce9e7e66d579.translation: Others are determined by the first-line Shell shebang (including __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, and __ELBOT_CODE_2__ syntax).

docs/configuration.md:list:1d18e9079b3de.source: 高风险工具确认消息附带 inline keyboard，点击会转为 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 等现有确认命令。
docs/configuration.md:list:1d18e9079b3de.translation: Confirmation messages for high-risk tools include an inline keyboard; clicking them will convert to existing confirmation commands such as __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and __ELBOT_CODE_1__.

docs/configuration.md:list:1f709fa9b8c42.source: 压缩：Responses 会话用当前对话模型原生压缩，不使用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的选择。命名与 Chat 会话文字摘要则两个客户端都可用。
docs/configuration.md:list:1f709fa9b8c42.translation: Compression: Responses Sessions use the native compression of the current conversation model, without using the __ELBOT_CODE_0__ option. Naming and text summaries for Chat Sessions are available on both clients.

docs/configuration.md:list:2184646a40e1f.source: 不要求鉴权时两项均可省略。
docs/configuration.md:list:2184646a40e1f.translation: Both items can be omitted when authentication is not required.

docs/configuration.md:list:2396764c277e7.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 无可识别 shebang 时按 Bash。
docs/configuration.md:list:2396764c277e7.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, and __ELBOT_CODE_2__ default to Bash when no recognizable shebang is found.

docs/configuration.md:list:2477266201345.source: 目标目录根部有 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 或 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 时，首次发现、注入或首次切换到该目录会自动把内容附带给 LLM。
docs/configuration.md:list:2477266201345.translation: When __ELBOT_CODE_0__ or __ELBOT_CODE_1__ is present at the root of the target directory, the content will be automatically attached to the LLM upon first discovery, injection, or first switch to that directory.

docs/configuration.md:list:249661b4c4687.source: stdout 也支持 __ELBOT_CODE_0__，格式与生命周期见 [Skill 使用媒体](concepts.md#skill-使用媒体)。
docs/configuration.md:list:249661b4c4687.translation: stdout also supports __ELBOT_CODE_0__; see [Skill Media Usage](concepts.md#skill-使用媒体) for format and lifecycle.

docs/configuration.md:list:282ff205a792f.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 可用 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 选 __ELBOT_CODE_2__，未配置时回退 __ELBOT_CODE_3__。
docs/configuration.md:list:282ff205a792f.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ can use __ELBOT_CODE_1__ to select __ELBOT_CODE_2__, and falls back to __ELBOT_CODE_3__ when not configured.

docs/configuration.md:list:2fae5fa7bbf2e.source: S3 使用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_3__、__ELBOT_CODE_4__ 指定的变量。
docs/configuration.md:list:2fae5fa7bbf2e.translation: S3 uses variables specified by __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, __ELBOT_CODE_2__ and __ELBOT_CODE_3__, __ELBOT_CODE_4__.

docs/configuration.md:list:320417d3eddb2.source: 未显式设 PATH 时用服务管理器提供的 PATH。
docs/configuration.md:list:320417d3eddb2.translation: Use the PATH provided by the service manager when PATH is not explicitly set.

docs/configuration.md:list:32df7d055a4fa.source: 技能执行顺序：进程 PATH → 配置根 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ → 技能 __ELBOT_CODE_1__；AgentSkill 命令也用它查找可执行文件。
docs/configuration.md:list:32df7d055a4fa.translation: Skill execution order: process PATH → configuration root __ELBOT_CODE_0__ → Skill __ELBOT_CODE_1__; the AgentSkill command also uses it to find executable files.

docs/configuration.md:list:332c2f9e7308e.source: 通过 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 元工具写入时，完整 reload 成功后才确认；reload 失败会恢复原 TOML，原先没有该文件则删除本次新建文件。
docs/configuration.md:list:332c2f9e7308e.translation: When writing via the __ELBOT_CODE_0__ meta-tool, it is only confirmed after a full reload succeeds; if reload fails, the original TOML will be restored, or the newly created file will be deleted if it did not exist previously.

docs/configuration.md:list:39dcaa1adf261.source: 共用变量放 __ELBOT_CODE_0__，单插件变量放插件目录 __ELBOT_CODE_1__；
docs/configuration.md:list:39dcaa1adf261.translation: Place shared variables in __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and single-plugin variables in the plugin directory __ELBOT_CODE_1__;

docs/configuration.md:list:3b5817e7beff4.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__：触发压缩的原图字节数阈值，默认 4 MiB。
docs/configuration.md:list:3b5817e7beff4.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__: The original image byte size threshold that triggers compression, default 4 MiB.

docs/configuration.md:list:3d704f176de82.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__：Elnis LLM 事件的可选模型槽位，Elvena 请求通过 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 指定，未配置时回退到 __ELBOT_CODE_2__。
docs/configuration.md:list:3d704f176de82.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__: Optional model slot for Elnis LLM events; Elvena requests are specified via __ELBOT_CODE_1__, falling back to __ELBOT_CODE_2__ when not configured.

docs/configuration.md:list:43b36882e312f.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 是全局回退值，默认 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，模型块里没配 __ELBOT_CODE_2__ 时使用。
docs/configuration.md:list:43b36882e312f.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is the global fallback value, defaulting to __ELBOT_CODE_1__, and is used when __ELBOT_CODE_2__ is not configured in the model block.

docs/configuration.md:list:49ed2bd949f29.source: 默认下群聊两种角色、私聊普通用户都是闲置 10 分钟开启新 Session，私聊超级管理员不过期。
docs/configuration.md:list:49ed2bd949f29.translation: By default, both roles in group chats and private chats with ordinary users will start a new Session after 10 minutes of idleness; private chats with superadmins do not expire.

docs/configuration.md:list:4e71042e4c072.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 是连接配置：__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 可省略（默认等于 __ELBOT_CODE_2__），__ELBOT_CODE_3__ 可省略（默认用 __ELBOT_CODE_4__）；
docs/configuration.md:list:4e71042e4c072.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is the connection configuration: __ELBOT_CODE_1__ can be omitted (defaults to __ELBOT_CODE_2__), __ELBOT_CODE_3__ can be omitted (defaults to __ELBOT_CODE_4__);

docs/configuration.md:list:4f0cf6efa3dbe.source: 文件名主体必须大写 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__，__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 后缀大小写不限，__ELBOT_CODE_3__ 优先。
docs/configuration.md:list:4f0cf6efa3dbe.translation: The main part of the filename must be uppercase __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__, the case of the __ELBOT_CODE_2__ suffix is unrestricted, and __ELBOT_CODE_3__ takes priority.

docs/configuration.md:list:552df26d96510.source: 两种协议共用上述开关、阈值和当前模型的窗口配置。
docs/configuration.md:list:552df26d96510.translation: Both protocols share the aforementioned switches, thresholds, and window configurations of the current model.

docs/configuration.md:list:57d7a385fa7c1.source: 处理私聊、群内 @ 和平台实际下发的普通群消息。
docs/configuration.md:list:57d7a385fa7c1.translation: Handles private chats, @ mentions in groups, and ordinary group messages actually delivered by the platform.

docs/configuration.md:list:57df6a24dc926.source: 激活的 tag 写入 Session metadata，__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 后仍生效。
docs/configuration.md:list:57df6a24dc926.translation: Activated tags are written to the Session metadata and remain effective after __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:595ff1d7bf173.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__：新 Session 默认进入 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 还是 __ELBOT_CODE_2__。
docs/configuration.md:list:595ff1d7bf173.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__: Whether a new Session enters __ELBOT_CODE_1__ or __ELBOT_CODE_2__ by default.

docs/configuration.md:list:5aa20ef333553.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 指向环境变量名，也可用 __ELBOT_CODE_2__ / __ELBOT_CODE_3__ 直接写入（不建议提交真实值）。
docs/configuration.md:list:5aa20ef333553.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ point to environment variable names; __ELBOT_CODE_2__ / __ELBOT_CODE_3__ can also be used to write values directly (not recommended to commit actual values).

docs/configuration.md:list:5b7dfd172bde0.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 指向保存 Client Secret 的环境变量名；
docs/configuration.md:list:5b7dfd172bde0.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ points to the environment variable name where the Client Secret is stored;

docs/configuration.md:list:5c3a53da6c437.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 模式支持单文件和目录查询。
docs/configuration.md:list:5c3a53da6c437.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ modes support single file and directory queries.

docs/configuration.md:list:5eaad1dbf0ffe.source: 文件不存在视为空配置。
docs/configuration.md:list:5eaad1dbf0ffe.translation: If the file does not exist, it is treated as an empty configuration.

docs/configuration.md:list:5ed25d22f670b.source: 普通群消息是否下发取决于 QQ 开放平台为机器人启用的群消息能力。
docs/configuration.md:list:5ed25d22f670b.translation: Whether ordinary group messages are delivered depends on the group message capabilities enabled for the bot by the QQ Open Platform.

docs/configuration.md:list:605a3c4a59754.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 分别作用于帧写入和 API 响应等待。
docs/configuration.md:list:605a3c4a59754.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ applies to frame writing and API response waiting, respectively.

docs/configuration.md:list:634d79716f5d6.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 是允许登录的 CLI client id 与 token 环境变量列表。
docs/configuration.md:list:634d79716f5d6.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is a list of environment variables for CLI client IDs and tokens allowed to log in.

docs/configuration.md:list:6805784692e33.source: 审计和 Elnis 日志独立保留，即使提高运行等级也会继续记录 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 所需的用量事实。
docs/configuration.md:list:6805784692e33.translation: Audit and Elnis logs are retained independently; usage facts required by __ELBOT_CODE_0__ will continue to be recorded even if the runtime level is increased.

docs/configuration.md:list:6c596c45f611b.source: 开启后，上下文接近窗口上限时自动压缩；也可用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 手动触发。
docs/configuration.md:list:6c596c45f611b.translation: When enabled, context is automatically compacted when it approaches the window limit; it can also be manually triggered using __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:6ce7563115d35.source: 原图超阈值或任一边长达到限制时等比例压缩。
docs/configuration.md:list:6ce7563115d35.translation: Proportional compression is applied when the original image exceeds the threshold or any side length reaches the limit.

docs/configuration.md:list:6dbbf3ab8e957.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 近似“中文按字数、英文按单词”：中日韩字符单字计 1，英文/数字连续片段计 1。
docs/configuration.md:list:6dbbf3ab8e957.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is similar to "Chinese by character count, English by word count": CJK characters are counted as 1 each, and continuous segments of English/numbers are counted as 1.

docs/configuration.md:list:72494d060ef8e.source: 基础值是 ElBot 启动时已获得的进程 PATH。
docs/configuration.md:list:72494d060ef8e.translation: The base value is the process PATH obtained when ElBot starts.

docs/configuration.md:list:733445b9e9f43.source: 默认资产清单中的文件是否缺失。
docs/configuration.md:list:733445b9e9f43.translation: Whether files in the default asset manifest are missing.

docs/configuration.md:list:765f707d7b158.source: 这里的“超级管理员”指 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 中配置的 ElBot 超级管理员；平台群主或群管理员不在该列表中时仍按普通用户处理。
docs/configuration.md:list:765f707d7b158.translation: The "superadmin" here refers to the ElBot superadmin configured in __ELBOT_CODE_0__; platform group owners or group administrators who are not in this list will still be treated as ordinary users.

docs/configuration.md:list:78432d997654a.source: 运行时 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 切换会同步保存到 __ELBOT_CODE_1__。
docs/configuration.md:list:78432d997654a.translation: Runtime __ELBOT_CODE_0__ switches will be synchronously saved to __ELBOT_CODE_1__.

docs/configuration.md:list:7c1d1bf7fdf14.source: 未写 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ / __ELBOT_CODE_2__：只作可见性配置，不注册成工具。
docs/configuration.md:list:7c1d1bf7fdf14.translation: If __ELBOT_CODE_0__ / __ELBOT_CODE_1__ / __ELBOT_CODE_2__ are not specified: it only serves as a visibility configuration and is not registered as a tool.

docs/configuration.md:list:7f5735996774f.source: ElBot 只读 Skill 根目录下的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__，不递归扫描。
docs/configuration.md:list:7f5735996774f.translation: ElBot only reads __ELBOT_CODE_0__ under the Skill root directory and does not scan recursively.

docs/configuration.md:list:805748c86e81d.source: LLM 传 __ELBOT_CODE_0__，宿主执行时导出为相对 Skill 根目录的临时文件路径。
docs/configuration.md:list:805748c86e81d.translation: LLM passes __ELBOT_CODE_0__, which is exported as a temporary file path relative to the Skill root directory during host execution.

docs/configuration.md:list:822672e9c49c5.source: 也可用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 直接写入，但不建议提交真实 Secret。
docs/configuration.md:list:822672e9c49c5.translation: You can also write it directly using __ELBOT_CODE_0__, but it is not recommended to commit the actual Secret.

docs/configuration.md:list:822e8a256cd31.source: 工具定义走原生输入的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__，当前调用权限由 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 限定，无可用工具时发 __ELBOT_CODE_2__。
docs/configuration.md:list:822e8a256cd31.translation: Tool definitions follow the __ELBOT_CODE_0__ of native input, current calling permissions are limited by __ELBOT_CODE_1__, and __ELBOT_CODE_2__ is sent when no tools are available.

docs/configuration.md:list:82dae3fc7caa3.source: 平台媒体在实际处理时才下载，不会收到即存 sandbox。纯文件消息也按统一唤醒规则处理。
docs/configuration.md:list:82dae3fc7caa3.translation: Platform media is downloaded only during actual processing and will not be stored directly in the sandbox. Pure file messages are also handled according to the unified wake-up rules.

docs/configuration.md:list:84fd2d47ff13d.translation: By default, server-side continuation is used;

docs/configuration.md:list:853f651ed69f9.source: 编辑撤销备份按目标绝对路径保存：切换 workspace 不清空备份，但相同相对路径按新 workspace 解析；
docs/configuration.md:list:853f651ed69f9.translation: Edit undo backups are saved by the target absolute path: switching the workspace does not clear backups, but the same relative path will be resolved according to the new workspace;

docs/configuration.md:list:86506f1dceff8.source: 内置 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 及配套 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 的内容差异；用户自己添加的 Skill 不参与比较。
docs/configuration.md:list:86506f1dceff8.translation: Content differences between the built-in __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and its accompanying __ELBOT_CODE_1__; Skills added by the user are not included in the comparison.

docs/configuration.md:list:8955495830382.source: 上游返回 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 时自动切换并后台记 WARN。
docs/configuration.md:list:8955495830382.translation: Automatically switch and log a WARN in the background when the upstream returns __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:8bec4ea68e8f9.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__: The side length limit after compression, default 4096.

docs/configuration.md:list:8d26328866134.source: 查询等级与记录等级独立：__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 只显示已有记录，不改配置、不补回未记录内容。筛选方式见[日志和审计命令](commands.md#日志和审计)。
docs/configuration.md:list:8d26328866134.translation: Query level and recording level are independent: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ only displays existing records, without changing configurations or recovering unrecorded content. For filtering methods, see [Log and Audit Commands](commands.md#日志和审计).

docs/configuration.md:list:9007631b84d54.source: 配置 TOML 的格式、重复定义和字段类型；__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 另外检查未知字段。
docs/configuration.md:list:9007631b84d54.translation: The format, duplicate definitions, and field types of the configuration TOML; __ELBOT_CODE_0__ additionally checks for unknown fields.

docs/configuration.md:list:914295088d3a8.source: 会话使用带版本的原生输入格式。缺少格式标记的旧会话不能继续对话、Fork 或压缩，需新建。同一原生历史中的工具定义固定，同名 schema 变化也需新建。
docs/configuration.md:list:914295088d3a8.translation: Sessions use a versioned native input format. Old Sessions lacking format markers cannot continue conversations, be Forked, or be compressed, and must be newly created. Tool definitions within the same native history are fixed; if a schema with the same name changes, a new Session must also be created.

docs/configuration.md:list:95285e9503bcc.source: CLI 默认本地用户 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 是超级管理员。
docs/configuration.md:list:95285e9503bcc.translation: The default local CLI user __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is a superadmin.

docs/configuration.md:list:9a1e2d6588e94.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 使用指定连接配置，未指定时用 __ELBOT_CODE_1__。
docs/configuration.md:list:9a1e2d6588e94.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ uses the specified connection configuration; if not specified, __ELBOT_CODE_1__ is used.

docs/configuration.md:list:9e1c16784381b.source: 直接 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 只预载指定工具，不激活 tag prompt。
docs/configuration.md:list:9e1c16784381b.translation: Using __ELBOT_CODE_0__ directly only preloads the specified tools and does not activate the tag prompt.

docs/configuration.md:list:9f5bbbbb6c66a.source: 注入 Prompt 时两段合并为一段自然文本。
docs/configuration.md:list:9f5bbbbb6c66a.translation: When injecting the Prompt, the two segments are merged into a single piece of natural text.

docs/configuration.md:list:9ff9b27c1cbfd.source: 媒体中心在所有引用释放满 1 小时后，按 __ELBOT_CODE_0__（默认每天 04:00）清理对象，且独立启用、不受 sandbox 清理开关影响；
docs/configuration.md:list:9ff9b27c1cbfd.translation: The Media Center cleans up objects according to __ELBOT_CODE_0__ (default 04:00 daily) after all references have been released for 1 hour; this is enabled independently and is not affected by the sandbox cleanup switch;

docs/configuration.md:list:a08c5f766400b.source: 执行时工作目录固定为 Skill 根目录，stdout 作为工具结果；
docs/configuration.md:list:a08c5f766400b.translation: The working directory during execution is fixed to the Skill root directory, and stdout serves as the tool result;

docs/configuration.md:list:a0921075adbe4.source: 配置根 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 不注入 Hook。
docs/configuration.md:list:a0921075adbe4.translation: The config root __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is not injected into Hooks.

docs/configuration.md:list:a0d8062f18309.source: 群聊/超级群组中，命令前缀、触发关键词、__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 或回复 bot 消息都会触发处理；私聊默认处理。
docs/configuration.md:list:a0d8062f18309.translation: In group chats/supergroups, command prefixes, trigger keywords, __ELBOT_CODE_0__, or replying to bot messages will trigger processing; private chats are processed by default.

docs/configuration.md:list:a2664ca1b364f.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 填 Telegram 用户 ID 或可直接发送的私聊 chat ID，用于超管权限与通知投递。
docs/configuration.md:list:a2664ca1b364f.translation: Fill in the Telegram user ID or a private chat ID that can be sent to directly in __ELBOT_CODE_0__, used for superadmin permissions and notification delivery.

docs/configuration.md:list:a41a474bd3b32.source: 未声明为媒体的字符串不转换。
docs/configuration.md:list:a41a474bd3b32.translation: Strings not declared as media are not converted.

docs/configuration.md:list:a4839c507682b.source: 若 stdout 是 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ JSON，取 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 字段。
docs/configuration.md:list:a4839c507682b.translation: If stdout is __ELBOT_CODE_0__ JSON, the __ELBOT_CODE_1__ field is used.

docs/configuration.md:list:a6cb52862ebc7.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ (when the service environment is configured with __ELBOT_CODE_1__)

docs/configuration.md:list:a90382342610f.source: 模型服务通过有效期 1 小时的预签名 URL 下载，无需另给密钥。
docs/configuration.md:list:a90382342610f.translation: Model services are downloaded via pre-signed URLs valid for 1 hour, without the need for additional keys.

docs/configuration.md:list:ab3a0bdb38d13.source: 由 ElBot 自行读取配置根 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 时，unit 不必重复加载该文件（PATH 按追加规则）。
docs/configuration.md:list:ab3a0bdb38d13.translation: When ElBot reads the configuration root __ELBOT_CODE_0__ itself, the unit does not need to load the file repeatedly (PATH follows the append rule).

docs/configuration.md:list:ab8b65ced0557.source: 单位分钟；设为 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 禁用对应场景的闲置过期。
docs/configuration.md:list:ab8b65ced0557.translation: Unit: minutes; set to __ELBOT_CODE_0__ to disable idle expiration for the corresponding scenario.

docs/configuration.md:list:aceae82420a81.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__：Provider 或模型级 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 可用 __ELBOT_CODE_2__ 关闭服务端存储，之后发送完整原生历史。
docs/configuration.md:list:aceae82420a81.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__: Provider or model-level __ELBOT_CODE_1__ can use __ELBOT_CODE_2__ to disable server-side storage, after which the full native history will be sent.

docs/configuration.md:list:af0d3ea356174.source: 重复预载已存在的工具不会重复添加，平台提示 __ELBOT_CODE_0__。
docs/configuration.md:list:af0d3ea356174.translation: Preloading existing tools repeatedly will not add them again, and the platform will prompt __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:b395db36bb39b.source: 配置 tag 追加到内置 tag，不覆盖。
docs/configuration.md:list:b395db36bb39b.translation: Configured tags are appended to the built-in tags, not overwritten.

docs/configuration.md:list:b57e144a71960.source: 上游必须支持这两项，没有顶层 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 回退。
docs/configuration.md:list:b57e144a71960.translation: The upstream must support these two items; there is no top-level __ELBOT_CODE_0__ fallback.

docs/configuration.md:list:b5c6a9014e034.source: 连接成功后会把内置 slash 命令同步到 bot 命令菜单，只同步主命令名、不同步 alias。
docs/configuration.md:list:b5c6a9014e034.translation: After a successful connection, built-in slash commands will be synchronized to the bot command menu; only the main command names are synchronized, not the aliases.

docs/configuration.md:list:b82483caec233.source: 撤销原目录文件可切回或传绝对路径。
docs/configuration.md:list:b82483caec233.translation: To undo files in the original directory, you can switch back or provide the absolute path.

docs/configuration.md:list:bf79d97054444.source: 超管的确认阈值由 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 配置。
docs/configuration.md:list:bf79d97054444.translation: The superadmin's confirmation threshold is configured by __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:c0697465466d2.source: Go Skill 编译阶段用基础环境，不加载技能 __ELBOT_CODE_0__。
docs/configuration.md:list:c0697465466d2.translation: The base environment is used during the Go Skill compilation phase, and Skill __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is not loaded.

docs/configuration.md:list:c18a738c75d9f.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 应写具体工具使用策略，不要写“当前 tag 是 xxx”这类模型无需知道的配置机制。
docs/configuration.md:list:c18a738c75d9f.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ should describe specific tool usage strategies; do not write configuration mechanisms that the model does not need to know, such as "the current tag is xxx".

docs/configuration.md:list:c31f4dd06ba99.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__：流式刷新节流间隔，默认 250ms，避免触发平台限频。
docs/configuration.md:list:c31f4dd06ba99.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__: Throttling interval for streaming updates, defaults to 250ms, to avoid triggering platform rate limits.

docs/configuration.md:list:c4e57ccbe1630.source: 写入失败或超时后 ElBot 断开重连，避免一次慢发送占住后续消息。
docs/configuration.md:list:c4e57ccbe1630.translation: ElBot disconnects and reconnects after a write failure or timeout to prevent a single slow send from blocking subsequent messages.

docs/configuration.md:list:c873e181bfa55.source: 一次性 exec、Persistent / Transient Worker 规则相同。
docs/configuration.md:list:c873e181bfa55.translation: One-time exec, Persistent / Transient Worker follow the same rules.

docs/configuration.md:list:c905c6ab81185.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 本身不影响 PATH，但文件里一旦含 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，systemd 会在启动前完整覆盖原值，ElBot 只能在此基础上追加，无法恢复已丢失的系统目录；
docs/configuration.md:list:c905c6ab81185.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ itself does not affect PATH, but if the file contains __ELBOT_CODE_1__, systemd will completely overwrite the original value before startup. ElBot can only append to this and cannot recover lost system directories;

docs/configuration.md:list:cb3b37a5129d7.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 中只写要增加的绝对目录。
docs/configuration.md:list:cb3b37a5129d7.translation: Only write the absolute directories to be added in __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:cf31e849b02af.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 指向保存 Access Token 的环境变量名；
docs/configuration.md:list:cf31e849b02af.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ points to the environment variable name where the Access Token is stored;

docs/configuration.md:list:d3e9e843be133.source: 平台配置目录：Windows __ELBOT_CODE_0__；Linux 使用 XDG 配置目录。
docs/configuration.md:list:d3e9e843be133.translation: Platform configuration directory: Windows __ELBOT_CODE_0__; Linux uses the XDG configuration directory.

docs/configuration.md:list:d80b230d1fc33.source: 内置 Skill 的 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的 TOML 格式。
docs/configuration.md:list:d80b230d1fc33.translation: The TOML format of __ELBOT_CODE_0__ for built-in Skills.

docs/configuration.md:list:d8c1ec8ddc4d4.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__：媒体下载超时，默认 60 秒；Telegram 用平台 API 超时。
docs/configuration.md:list:d8c1ec8ddc4d4.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__: Media download timeout, default 60 seconds; Telegram uses the platform API timeout.

docs/configuration.md:list:dc8cd621c3724.source: 预签名 URL 到期只影响链接，不删对象。
docs/configuration.md:list:dc8cd621c3724.translation: The expiration of a pre-signed URL only affects the link and does not delete the object.

docs/configuration.md:list:de55e217f1cb7.source: 内部工具白名单、外部工具开关、投递禁用、token、Elwisp 策略均在 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 中配置。
docs/configuration.md:list:de55e217f1cb7.translation: Internal tool whitelists, external tool switches, delivery disabling, tokens, and Elwisp policies are all configured in __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:list:de74c3b72719b.source: 大帧按编码后大小每完整 1 MiB 加 1 秒，最多加到基础超时本身；
docs/configuration.md:list:de74c3b72719b.translation: For large frames, 1 second is added for every full 1 MiB of encoded size, up to the base timeout itself;

docs/configuration.md:list:df6f5247c1fa3.translation: The original __ELBOT_CODE_0__ remains compatible and takes priority.

docs/configuration.md:list:e3b5c37247952.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 每次从文件动态读取，变更影响后续请求（类似 __ELBOT_CODE_1__）。
docs/configuration.md:list:e3b5c37247952.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is dynamically read from the file each time; changes will affect subsequent requests (similar to __ELBOT_CODE_1__).

docs/configuration.md:list:e7c5c938b5915.source: 若 unit 用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 加载同一文件，PATH 必须写成完整值，且其中全部变量都成为进程环境、被 Shell 和 Hook 继承，失去“配置根 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 不注入 Hook”的隔离。
docs/configuration.md:list:e7c5c938b5915.translation: If the unit uses __ELBOT_CODE_0__ to load the same file, PATH must be written as a full value. All variables within it will become part of the process environment and be inherited by Shell and Hook, losing the isolation of "configuration root __ELBOT_CODE_1__ is not injected into Hook".

docs/configuration.md:list:e949cfb474df9.source: 信号派发、后台信号任务和日志写入等设施故障直接报告到 stderr（不受日志等级过滤）；运行期报告后继续运行，初始化失败则返回主程序处理。
docs/configuration.md:list:e949cfb474df9.translation: Facility failures such as signal dispatch, background signal tasks, and log writing are reported directly to stderr (not filtered by log level); the system continues to run after reporting during runtime, but returns to the main program for handling if initialization fails.

docs/configuration.md:list:e9f3bdd5fc784.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 同时控制本地图片、文件和 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 语音的发送：__ELBOT_CODE_2__ 适用于不共享文件系统的部署，__ELBOT_CODE_3__ 仅适用于双方能访问同一路径。
docs/configuration.md:list:e9f3bdd5fc784.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ simultaneously controls the sending of local images, files, and __ELBOT_CODE_1__ voice messages: __ELBOT_CODE_2__ is suitable for deployments that do not share a file system, while __ELBOT_CODE_3__ is only applicable when both parties can access the same path.

docs/configuration.md:list:ea4d01e97acbb.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 只能进一步收窄权限，强制调用不可用工具或无工具时设 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 会报错。
docs/configuration.md:list:ea4d01e97acbb.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ can only further narrow permissions; setting __ELBOT_CODE_1__ when forcing the call of unavailable tools or when no tools exist will result in an error.

docs/configuration.md:list:ea60cee70fe7b.source: 日志只记录 token name，不写 token 原文。
docs/configuration.md:list:ea60cee70fe7b.translation: Logs only record the token name and do not write the original token text.

docs/configuration.md:list:eaebcceba9232.source: 方言判定：__ELBOT_CODE_0__ 按 Go，__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 按 mksh；
docs/configuration.md:list:eaebcceba9232.translation: Dialect determination: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ follows Go, __ELBOT_CODE_1__ follows mksh;

docs/configuration.md:list:ec57450bd0300.source: 需要代理时在对应环境层设 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__；子进程是否使用取决于具体程序。
docs/configuration.md:list:ec57450bd0300.translation: When a proxy is required, set __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, and __ELBOT_CODE_2__ in the corresponding environment layer; whether child processes use them depends on the specific program.

docs/configuration.md:list:ed182dd30c2a1.source: 附带上限 64 KiB。超限不读取、不标记已附带，工具结果提示缩短或拆分后重新切换。
docs/configuration.md:list:ed182dd30c2a1.translation: The attachment limit is 64 KiB. If the limit is exceeded, the content will not be read or marked as attached, and the tool result will prompt to shorten or split the content before switching again.

docs/configuration.md:list:f0673857759f6.source: 连其他机器时写远程 WebSocket 地址。
docs/configuration.md:list:f0673857759f6.translation: Enter the remote WebSocket address when connecting to other machines.

docs/configuration.md:list:f10435c6daf57.source: 媒体参数在 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 声明为 __ELBOT_CODE_1__，仍通过 __ELBOT_CODE_2__ 映射 flag；
docs/configuration.md:list:f10435c6daf57.translation: Media parameters are declared as __ELBOT_CODE_1__ in __ELBOT_CODE_0__, and flags are still mapped via __ELBOT_CODE_2__;

docs/configuration.md:list:f1fbfe65ad59d.source: 群聊沿用统一唤醒规则：slash 命令、__ELBOT_CODE_0__、@ 机器人或引用机器人的历史回复触发响应；未触发的普通群消息仍写入聊天历史。
docs/configuration.md:list:f1fbfe65ad59d.translation: Group chats follow the unified wake-up rules: slash commands, __ELBOT_CODE_0__, @ mentioning the bot, or quoting the bot's historical replies will trigger a response; ordinary group messages that are not triggered are still written to the chat history.

docs/configuration.md:list:f381a8d99511d.source: 写了任一工具化字段：必须补齐完整工具化配置。
docs/configuration.md:list:f381a8d99511d.translation: If any tooling field is specified: the complete tooling configuration must be provided.

docs/configuration.md:list:f39f0b705c6a3.source: 两种模式的区别见 [Chat / Work 双模式](concepts.md#chat--work-双模式)。
docs/configuration.md:list:f39f0b705c6a3.translation: For the difference between the two modes, see [Chat / Work Dual Mode](concepts.md#chat--work-双模式).

docs/configuration.md:list:f4acd46415a6d.source: 删除失败保留记录待重试，仍被 Session 或聊天历史引用的不删。
docs/configuration.md:list:f4acd46415a6d.translation: Records of failed deletions are kept for retry; objects still referenced by a Session or chat history will not be deleted.

docs/configuration.md:list:f8554c69d749e.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 只在启动时读取，运行中手动修改需重启生效。
docs/configuration.md:list:f8554c69d749e.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is only read at startup; manual modifications during runtime require a restart to take effect.

docs/configuration.md:list:f97edd8785909.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 时，__ELBOT_CODE_1__ 会启动 CLI WebSocket 服务端，监听 __ELBOT_CODE_2__。
docs/configuration.md:list:f97edd8785909.translation: When __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__ will start the CLI WebSocket server and listen on __ELBOT_CODE_2__.

docs/configuration.md:list:fa9ad18fe272d.source: 日志文件按日轮转，前缀为 __ELBOT_CODE_0__、__ELBOT_CODE_1__、__ELBOT_CODE_2__，保留天数由 __ELBOT_CODE_3__ 控制。
docs/configuration.md:list:fa9ad18fe272d.translation: Log files are rotated daily with prefixes __ELBOT_CODE_0__, __ELBOT_CODE_1__, and __ELBOT_CODE_2__; the number of days to retain is controlled by __ELBOT_CODE_3__.

docs/configuration.md:list:ff2b345ab1d06.source: 发送仍同步等待平台回执。
docs/configuration.md:list:ff2b345ab1d06.translation: Sending still synchronously waits for the platform receipt.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:059c711b.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 不参与普通覆盖，而是按层级追加并去重：
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:059c711b.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ does not participate in ordinary overriding, but is instead appended by layer and deduplicated:

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:0d02ab9e.source: work 模式下，超级管理员可让 LLM 调用 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 工具切换当前 Session 的共享工作目录。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:0d02ab9e.translation: In work mode, the superadmin can allow the LLM to call the __ELBOT_CODE_0__ tool to switch the shared working directory of the current Session.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:100aeaad.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 中的 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 控制当前 Session 的闲置过期时间，单位为分钟：
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:100aeaad.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_1__ in __ELBOT_CODE_0__ controls the idle expiration time of the current Session, in minutes:

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:1804536f.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 保存运行态模型选择（三个 elwisp 槽位结构相同）：
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:1804536f.translation: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ saves the runtime model selection (the three Elwisp slots have the same structure):

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:23407111.source: 已有会话的协议和厂商在首次对话时固定。厂商即 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 的节点名。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:23407111.translation: The protocol and provider of an existing Session are fixed during the first conversation. The provider refers to the node name of __ELBOT_CODE_0__.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:2728204c.source: 除 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 外，所有配置文件均由内置 assets 首次运行时自动生成到平台配置目录，已存在的文件不会被覆盖。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:2728204c.translation: Except for __ELBOT_CODE_0__, all configuration files are automatically generated from built-in assets to the platform configuration directory upon the first run; existing files will not be overwritten.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:30bc7abe.source: 超级管理员可在聊天窗口执行 __ELBOT_CODE_0__，只读检查当前服务实际使用的主配置及其 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 指向的分离配置（支持自定义主配置文件名、相对/绝对路径；
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:30bc7abe.translation: The superadmin can execute __ELBOT_CODE_0__ in the chat window to perform a read-only check of the main configuration currently used by the service and the separated configuration pointed to by __ELBOT_CODE_1__ (supporting custom main configuration file names and relative/absolute paths;

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:30da517c.source: __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 非空时从本轮起追加到 system prompt。
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:30da517c.translation: When __ELBOT_CODE_0__ is not empty, it will be appended to the system prompt starting from this round.

docs/configuration.md:paragraph:313abe53.source: 平台配置不存在时会自动生成默认配置（已存在的文件不覆盖），但自动生成只在没有显式 __ELBOT_CODE_0__ 和 __ELBOT_CODE_1__ 时触发；
docs/configuration.md:paragraph:313abe53.translation: When the platform configuration does not exist, a default configuration will be automatically generated (existing files will not be overwritten), but automatic generation is only triggered when there are no explicit __ELBOT_CODE_0__ and __ELBOT_CODE_1__;
